Description: Verify app starts with bootstrapApplication and appConfig providers are correct.
Test Steps: Start app, ensure no duplicate router/provider errors in console.

Description: Confirm standalone components declare required imports (Forms, CommonModule, Router etc.).
Test Steps: Open each standalone component and check `imports` array.

Description: Verify routes that require auth include `canActivate: [authGuard]` and intended role checks.
Test Steps: Attempt to access protected route while logged out and expect redirect to /login.
Notes: Add `data.role` where role-based access is needed.

Description: Ensure guard sets returnUrl and login flow redirects back to it after successful login.
Test Steps: Access /dashboard while logged out; after login expect redirect to original URL.
Notes: Update LoginComponent to honor query param if missing.

Description: Confirm team understands this is demo-level client-side auth; note production requirements (tokens, backend).
Test Steps: Review README and security docs; list TODOs for migrating to backend auth.

Description: Wrap localStorage reads/writes in try/catch and provide fallback in-memory store.
Test Steps: Run app in privacy mode or restricted env; ensure no uncaught exceptions from storage calls.
Notes: Implement a storage util for safe access.

Description: productSales is in-memory only; if sales must be durable, persist it to localStorage or backend.
Test Steps: Buy a product, reload page, confirm sales counts persist if required.
Notes: Recommend serializing map to object in saveToStorage().

Description: Verify components subscribe to Observables only (use `.asObservable()`), not to `.value` directly unless intentional.
Test Steps: Scan codebase for `.value` usages in components.
Notes: Prefer immutable updates via new arrays/objects.

Description: Check for potential ID collisions in multi-tab or multiple clients; consider UUIDs or persisted counters.
Test Steps: Open two tabs and add products/users to see ID behavior.
Notes: Note: OK for local demo only.

Description: Ensure purchaseProduct enforces login, role==buyer and sufficient stock. Check clear error messages returned.
Test Steps: Attempt purchase as logged-out, as seller, and with insufficient quantity; assert returned errors.

Description: Review `needsUpdate` logic that may overwrite user-modified products; ensure intended behavior and document it.
Test Steps: Modify local products to fewer than 8; reload and confirm whether overwritten.
Notes: Consider a migration strategy instead of silent overwrite.

Description: Login should redirect to `returnUrl` (if present) rather than default `/dashboard`.
Test Steps: Simulate guard redirect with `?returnUrl=/payment/1/1` and complete login; expect redirect there.
Notes: Update LoginComponent to read router query params.

Description: Ensure form fields have labels and ARIA roles, popup dialogs manage focus.
Test Steps: Run lighthouse/accessibility checks on login and key pages.

Description: Add unit tests covering login/logout, addUser (duplicate), addProduct, purchaseProduct success/failure.
Test Steps: Run `ng test` and confirm new tests pass.
Notes: Include edge cases and storage mocking.

Item: Enforce lint and tests in CI
Description: Ensure pipeline runs lint, typecheck and unit tests; PRs fail if checks fail.
Test Steps: Open PR with intentional lint error to verify CI rejects it (test env permitting).

Description: Avoid logging sensitive user data to console or storing unnecessary PII in localStorage.
Test Steps: Scan code for console.log calls that include user objects and sanitize them.
Notes: Replace verbose logs with debug-level guarded logs.

Description: Consider using storage events to sync logout/login across browser tabs if needed.
Test Steps: Login in one tab and logout in another; observe state handling.

Description: Document which localStorage keys are used (`currentUser`, `users`, `products`, `seller_{id}_products`) and how to reset.
Test Steps: Open README and confirm doc presence.
Notes: Add migration steps if structure changes.
